Sir, the empire is breathing but not yet earning — zero revenue across all fronts, and that is the only number that matters right now.

Caselle has seven products sitting in a queue that have never been seen by a buyer, Lumière is scheduled to go live on May 20th with 80 designs ready, and Atelier on Fiverr has no confirmed active gigs. Maximus goes live for gold trading on May 20th as well, so that clock is ticking. The most urgent problem is that our competitor and trend data feeds are broken, meaning design decisions for Caselle are flying blind.

May 20th is the line, sir — Lumière launches, Maximus activates, and I want those seven Caselle products published the same day.
Fix it then, you have access to to claude code

Sir, the data feeds are being fixed now — Claude is on it.

May 20th remains the hard line: Lumière launches, Maximus activates, and all seven Caselle products go live the same day.

While the pipeline repairs, I'm not waiting — I'm publishing product now.

Sir, the single highest-leverage marketing move right now is getting our products in front of people who are already searching for them — and that means SEO-optimised listing titles and tags, not paid ads, because we have zero sales data to optimise ad spend against.

For Lumière launching May 20th with 80 designs, the titles and tags on every single listing need to be built around what buyers are actually typing into Etsy search, not what we think sounds good — that alone can be the difference between zero impressions and consistent organic traffic.

For Caselle, every product needs a Pinterest pin the moment it goes live, because Pinterest drives Etsy and POD traffic better than any other free channel and the content lives for months.

The third move is a TikTok or Instagram Reel showing the product in context — lifestyle, not product shot — because that is what converts cold audiences in 2026.

I am filing all three as infrastructure builds now so they run automatically at launch without you touching anything.
